description: Capability for all Synapse windows. Sticky notes are created at runtime, one window per note, hence the note-* glob (Tauri matches this field with glob::Pattern; note ids are hex-only so none can contain a metacharacter). 'notes-hub' deliberately does NOT match 'note-*' - it is 'notes-', one character away from colliding. Window labels here must stay in step with the consts in src/lib.rs: renaming one without the other silently kills all IPC in that window.
